description: Acterys Reporting Acterys Reporting is a streamlined Power BI visual designed for fast, professional financial reporting—no deep DAX knowledge required. Built for teams that need clean, IBCS-compliant reports in Power BI, it offers essential features to customize, comment, and visualize financial data with ease. With flexible subtotal and custom row/column calculations, automated financial formatting, and simple variance visualizations, Acterys Reporting helps analysts and decision-makers create clear, presentation-ready reports in less time. This version integrates smoothly with Acterys’ planning features, making it ideal for finance users looking to cover the basics of financial reporting and performance tracking—quickly and efficiently. Key Features: Custom Row & Column Calculations: Insert subtotals or key metrics directly into your report—anywhere you need them. Automated Financial Formatting: Apply percent signs, underlines, brackets, and scaling based on your data model. Variance Visualizations: Show absolute or relative variances with optional waterfall-style visuals. Rich Text Commenting: Add comments at the row or cell level to clarify assumptions and highlight insights. Integration with Acterys Planning: Access core planning and budgeting functions within Power BI. Key Benefits: Faster Report Building: Skip the heavy DAX work and go straight to insight.…
